problem:
If $B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 3x+2 & 2x-4\end{aligned}]$
is a singular matrix, calculate the value of $x.$

$x=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The matrix $B$ is singular if and only if $det(B)=0.$ Calculating the determinant, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B) & =1\cdot (2x-4)-2\cdot (3x+2) \\  & =2x-4-6x-4 \\  & =-4x-8.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we set the determinant equal to $0$ and solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}-4x-8 & =0 \\ -4x & =8 \\ x & =-2\end{aligned}
$$
